query:
UPDATE deal_pipelines
         SET name = COALESCE($3, name),
             type = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE type END,
             sorting = COALESCE($6, sorting),
             meta = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE meta END,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
